verdict.rationale: The Temporal CLI has a documented batch command group: you can show the progress of an ongoing batch job by job ID, which implies batch jobs that act across many Workflow Executions. The Client can also list Workflow Executions, which is a way to select items in bulk. The evidence for bulk operations is a single thin mention, so what can actually be done in bulk is undocumented here. Missing for 10: documentation of which bulk actions exist (e.g. signal, cancel, terminate, reset), how executions are selected (e.g. by query), any bulk operations from the Web UI or API, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
